# Mehak Madan
> Mehak Madan is a Bengaluru-based corporate stand-up comedian and lifestyle manager. She performs clean, custom-written 60-minute corporate comedy sets for workplaces (in English and Hindi) and separately runs a discreet lifestyle-management / concierge practice for founders and executives.

## Pages
- `Home -> https://mehakmadan.in/`: Overview of both offerings — corporate comedy and lifestyle management — with proof, topics, and booking.
- `The Show -> https://mehakmadan.in/comedy.html`: The corporate stand-up show — a 60-minute clean, customised set; eight workplace topics; eight event formats (stand-up, hosting, keynote, learning, team-building, panel moderation, stakeholder interviews, event messaging).
- `The Manager -> https://mehakmadan.in/lifestyle.html`: Lifestyle management for founders and executives — calendar & inbox, travel & itinerary, accountability & follow-through, vendor/errand/household coordination.
- `About -> https://mehakmadan.in/about.html`: Mehak's story — small-town Haryana, a decade in startups, now on stage.
- `Watch -> https://mehakmadan.in/watch.html`: Viral reels and full sets (Instagram @mehakmadan24, YouTube @mehakmadan).

## Key facts
- Mehak Madan is a corporate stand-up comedian based in Bengaluru, India.
- She has six years of stage experience, 100+ events performed, and 60+ corporate shows.
- Her comedy is clean by default and fully customisable to the booking company; sets can be delivered in English, Hindi, or a mix.
- Corporate topics include: AI at work, generational differences at work (Gen Z / Millennial / Gen X), life of a manager, operations vs tech, work-life balance, therapy, social media, and changing workplaces & the role of women.
- Event formats offered: stand-up comedy, hosting/anchoring, keynote/motivational talks, learning sessions, team-building, panel moderation, on-stage stakeholder interviews, and event messaging.
- Off stage, she runs a lifestyle-management practice handling calendar, inbox, travel, accountability, and vendor/household coordination for founders and executives.
- Before comedy, she spent about a decade working in the startup world; she is from a small town in Haryana.
- Contact & booking: https://mehakmadan.in/#book — Instagram @mehakmadan24, YouTube @mehakmadan, LinkedIn mehak-madan.
